remarks.name: Nikunj Kothari
remarks.role: partner fpvventures - investing in seed/A. previous: early hire meter, opendoor, atlassian & others. love shimoleejhaveri + 👦👧
remarks.text:
I have been obsessed with self driving companies  for more than a year now.. tried a LOT of products, none of them met the bar and decided to just build one myself with "claude" in the loop.

Introducing my first experiment: nosugarforkids (dot com) 🙅‍♂️

> catalog of only healthy snacks for kids (surprisingly this didn't exist)
> you can chat to get recommendations for school, lunches, snack boxes
> built a "tier" list based on the nutrients and what's actually good

On the autonomous side, I have a Claude agent that wakes up once a day to do the following things:

> checks catalog for new additions
> prunes any products that may be dead
> finds new content ideas to help increase reach
> checks dataforSEO and Google Search Console for performance
> writes and edits new pieces that might be useful to help
> keeps quality high, and tries to not introduce slop
> (new) reaches out to publications to get backlinks

Even with ZERO backlinks today and no social presence whatsoever, site has organically grown to ~6k impressions a day and 60 clicks. 

Lots of rough edges still, but parents give it a try and tell me if it's helpful!
remarks.translation: 我痴迷自动驾驶公司已经一年多了……试过很多产品，没有一个达到标准，于是决定自己动手做一个，并把“claude”纳入流程中。介绍我的第一个实验：nosugarforkids (dot com) 🙅‍♂️ > 只收录儿童健康零食的目录（令人惊讶的是，这种东西以前并不存在） > 你可以通过聊天获取针对学校、午餐、零食盒的推荐 > 根据营养成分和真正有益的东西建立了一个“等级”列表 在自主运行方面，我有一个 Claude 智能体，每天醒来一次，执行以下任务： > 检查目录中是否有新增内容 > 清理任何可能已失效的产品 > 寻找新的内容创意，帮助扩大覆盖面 > 检查 dataforSEO 和 Google Search Console 的表现 > 撰写和编辑可能有帮助的新内容 > 保持高质量，并尽量避免引入垃圾内容 > （新增）联系出版物以获取反向链接 即使今天反向链接为零，也完全没有社交存在感，网站已经自然增长到每天约 6k 次展示和 60 次点击。仍然有很多粗糙之处，但家长们可以试试看，并告诉我它是否有帮助！

remarks.name: Cat Wu
remarks.role: claude code + cowork anthropicai, prev: dagster, scale_ai
remarks.text:
In the new Projects experience, Claude coordinates all of your sessions. 

I've been using it every day since it lets me operate at a higher level of abstraction. I fire off a batch of tasks and move on. Claude has context on everything I'm working on and can give me an aggregated status update whenever I ask. It also has long-lived memory that evolves as I use it. 

We're rolling this out over the coming weeks. Let me know what you think!
remarks.translation: 在新的 Projects 体验中，Claude 协调你的所有会话。我每天都在使用它，因为它让我能够在更高的抽象层次上运作。我发出一批任务，然后继续做别的事。Claude 掌握我正在处理的一切上下文，并且无论我何时询问，都能给我一份汇总的状态更新。它还具有随着我使用而不断演进的长期记忆。我们将在未来几周内逐步推出这一功能。告诉我你的想法！

podcasts.excerpt: 几年前，加州理工学院教授、Accelerated Understanding联合创始人Anima Anandkumar着手开发首个基于AI的开源天气模型。在与该领域专家交流时，她遭遇了质疑。天气是混沌的，物理模拟很难，已经发展了几十年，而且需要超级计算机，数据根本不够。尽管有这些保留意见，Anima还是毅然前行并开始构建。不到一年，她的团队就开发出了FourCastNet，一个能与现有最佳物理模拟相媲美的预测模型。多亏了Anima及其后续工作，现在任何人都可以使用消费级GPU在短时间尺度上准确预测天气。在我们发布的约十五期科学类节目中，<a target="_blank" href="http://latent.…
podcasts.originalExcerpt: A few years ago, Caltech Prof. and co-founder of Accelerated Understanding, Anima Anandkumar set out to develop the first open-source weather model with AI. Talking to experts in the field, she was met with skepticism. Weather is chaotic, physics simulations are hard, have been developed for decades, and require supercomputers, the data just isn’t there. Despite reservations, Anima went forth and built. Within a year her team had developed FourCastNet, a predictive model that is competitive with the best physics-based simulations available. Thanks to Anima, and her follow up work, anyone can now predict weather accurately over a short timescale using consumer grade GPUs.
